# Canonical style fixtures

These are exact copies of the model-visible `prompt/docs/authoritative/` styles.
They are included under tests because the Docker grader mounts only that subtree.
BibTeX summary §8 requires the canonical styles to reproduce BibTeX 0.99c output.
